events.title: 'Part of the Game' affair: citizenship offered for investment (reported)
events.description: An NGO post recalls that in 2009 the then deputy governor of Carinthia held out the prospect of citizenship to the adviser of a Russian investor in return for an investment plus a party donation.
events.quote: der damalige stellvertretende Kärntner Landeshauptmann hatte 2009 dem Berater eines russischen Investors im Gegenzug für eine Investition (plus Parteispende) eine Staatsbürgerschaft in Aussicht gestellt

events.title: Justice Ministry working group starts drafting citizenship law changes (reported)
events.description: The deputy justice minister told Capital that work on the draft amendments (which would remove citizenship for investment) had been going on since February 2018.
events.quote: По проекта за промени в закона се работи от близо година - от февруари 2018 г.

events.title: Contract on UAE-Comoros citizenship exchange signed (reported)
events.description: The Guardian saw a leather-bound contract dated April 2008, signed by a UAE official on behalf of a private corporation and by the Comorian defence minister, approving Comoro Gulf Holding's chairman as mediator of a UAE-Comoros citizenship exchange.
events.quote: a leather-bound contract, dated April 2008

events.title: MPs flown to Kuwait on a trip organised by the scheme's promoter (reported)
events.description: On 8 October 2008 officials including six of the bill's most vocal opponents were flown to Kuwait for a three-day all-expenses-paid "fact-finding mission" before the next parliamentary vote.
events.location: opening section and section on the trip
events.quote: Six of the law’s most vocal opponents were among those invited.

events.title: President announces UAE payment for documenting Bidoon families (reported)
events.description: In spring 2009 President Sambi announced the UAE would send over $200m for documenting 4,000 Bidoon families; about $25m for the budget and $175m for roads, sanitation and power.
events.quote: In the spring of 2009, President Sambi announced that the UAE was due to send over $200m

events.title: Moroni court rules Comoro Gulf Holding owes the state USD 16m (reported)
events.description: A court in Moroni ruled that Comoro Gulf Holding owed the state USD 16m from the economic citizenship programme. Judgment not seen.
events.quote: In April 2015, a Moroni court ruled that Comoro Gulf Holding owed the state USD $16m from the economic citizenship programme.

events.title: State orders seizure of Comoro Gulf Holding assets (reported)
events.description: The state ordered the seizure of company assets on the islands: 184 pieces of machinery, a stockroom and three piles of sand, per a local newspaper relayed by the Guardian.
events.quote: In May, the state ordered the seizure of company assets on the islands

events.title: Former president Sambi placed in pre-trial detention (reported)
events.description: RFI reports that Sambi had been in pre-trial detention since August 2018, a detention the United Nations had called arbitrary.
events.quote: sa détention préventive depuis août 2018 a été jugée « arbitraire » par les Nations unies

events.title: Cyprus tightens eligibility rules (reported)
events.description: Cyprus banned anyone under investigation, wanted, convicted or under international sanctions from buying a passport.
events.quote: In May 2019, Cyprus introduced tougher rules on who was eligible for citizenship

events.title: Parliament passes law allowing removal of citizenship (reported)
events.description: The law lets Cyprus remove citizenship from anyone who commits a serious crime, is wanted by Interpol or is sanctioned within 10 years of buying a passport; MPs voted against publishing buyers' names.
events.quote: Cypriot parliamentarians in July finally passed a law that gave the country the power to remove citizenship

events.title: Economic citizenship scheme suspended (reported)
events.description: An industry blog says Grenada suspended the scheme in October 2001 after pressure from US and Canadian authorities following 9/11.
events.quote: After pressure from US and Canadian authorities Grenada had to suspend the economic citizenship scheme in Oct 2001.

events.title: Tonga creates 'Tongan Protected Person Passports' (reported)
events.description: Academic account: the King and Privy Council created Protected Person Passports in 1982, sold mainly in Hong Kong, conferring no citizenship or residence. The programme record gives 1983 from another source.
events.quote: In 1982, the King and Privy Council of Tonga created ‘Tongan Protected Person Passports’, which were sold mainly in Hong Kong.

events.title: Tonga amends Nationality Act to allow naturalisation for a fee (reported)
events.description: Academic account: the 1984 amendment let the King naturalise any foreigner of 'good character on humanitarian grounds' for a prescribed fee, turning passport sales into citizenship sales.
events.quote: In Tonga, the sale of passports became the sale of citizenship in 1984 when the Nationality Act was amended

events.title: Tonga discontinues citizenship sales after court challenge (reported)
events.description: Academic account: after a court challenge the scheme was discontinued in 1988.
events.quote: After a court challenge, the scheme was discontinued in 1988.

events.title: Tonga briefly reintroduces citizenship sales (reported)
events.description: Academic account: briefly reintroduced in 1996, with Protected Person Passport holders given the right to apply for naturalisation (Nationality (Amendment) Act 1996).
events.quote: It was briefly reintroduced in 1996, along with provisions giving holders of Protected Person Passports the right to apply for naturalisation.

events.title: Marshall Islands citizenship sales begin (reported)
events.description: Academic account: discretionary naturalisation for 'distinguished service' in exchange for a prescribed fee enabled sales between 1987 and 1996 (Citizenship Act 1984 s 404). The programme record gives 1989 from another source.
events.quote: enabled the sale of citizenship in the Marshall Islands between 1987 and 1996

events.title: Marshall Islands citizenship sales end (reported)
events.description: Academic account: the programme ended in 1996, when the United States made entry on Marshallese passports more difficult. The programme record gives 2001 (repeal of s 404) from another source.
events.quote: The program ended at the same time that the United States made migration and entry to the United States on Marshallese passports more difficult.

events.title: Nauru creates 'citizen investor' category (reported)
events.description: Academic account: Nauru legislated in 1997 (Nauruan Community Act 1956-1997 s 5(6)-(9)) for a 'citizen investor' who made an investment as determined by Cabinet.
events.quote: Nauru legislated in 1997 to create a category of ‘citizen investor’

events.title: Vanuatu Ombudsman exposes sale of diplomatic passports (reported)
events.description: Academic account: in 1998 the Ombudsman exposed senior officials issuing diplomatic passports to 'honorary consuls' and sham positions for payment.
events.quote: In 1998, the Vanuatu Ombudsman exposed high level government officials who were issuing diplomatic passports

events.title: Samoa adopts Citizenship Investment Act 2015 (reported)
events.description: Academic account: a path to citizenship for persons of a minimum net worth who invest a set amount within three years; investors and family get permanent residence and can apply for citizenship after three years (five for ordinary naturalisation).
events.quote: In Samoa, the Citizenship Investment Act 2015 provides a pathway to Samoan citizenship for persons of a minimum net worth

events.title: Government terminates investment agreement with MSR Media (reported)
events.description: The government ended its investment agreement with MSR Media SKN Ltd and MSR Hotels & Co. Ltd, citing failures to renovate tourism infrastructure, employ agreed numbers of citizens and deliver films.
events.quote: The government also terminated its investment agreement with MSR Media SKN Ltd and MSR Hotels & Co. Ltd for multiple contractual breaches.

events.title: Suspended agent Latitude reinstated (reported)
events.description: IMI Daily's later note says the CIU confirmed Latitude Consultancy's reinstatement and authorisation to resume operations effective 31 October 2025.
events.quote: confirming its reinstatement and authorization to resume operations within the nation’s CBI program effective 31 October 2025

events.title: Citizenship-by-investment programme launched (reported)
events.description: NewsMaker says the programme was launched in November 2018.
events.quote: Programul de dobândire a cetățeniei Republicii Moldova prin investiție a fost lansat în noiembrie 2018.

events.title: Four-month moratorium on new applications (reported)
events.description: A moratorium on receiving applications started on 23 August 2019 for four months.
events.quote: moratoriul privind dobândirea cetățeniei prin investiție a fost instituit începând cu 23 august, pe o perioadă de patru luni

events.title: Moratorium extended by two months (reported)
events.description: By government decision the moratorium was extended by two more months from 20 December 2019; parliament later did not extend it.
events.quote: prin decizie de guvern, începând cu 20 decembrie, moratoriul a fost prelungit cu încă două luni

events.title: Government decision on criteria for economic citizenship adopted (reported)
events.description: The government decision on criteria, method and procedure for selecting persons who can acquire citizenship on this basis was adopted in November 2018.
events.quote: odluka o kriterijumima, načinu i postupku izbora lica koja mogu steći crnogorsko državljanstvo po ovom osnovu donijeta u novembru 2018. godine

events.title: Public call for tourism development projects issued (reported)
events.description: The public call for projects to qualify for the list of tourism development projects was issued in February 2019.
events.quote: javni poziv za kvalifikovanje projekata na Listu razvojnih projekata u oblasti turizma raspisan u februaru 2019. godine

events.title: Special investment programme ends (reported)
events.description: The programme ran until 31 December 2022; processing of received applications and transfers continued afterwards.
events.quote: Program je trajao do 31. decembra 2022. godine

events.title: Permanent Residence Law No. 10 of 2018 adopted (reported)
events.description: GLMM gives 4 September 2018 as the date of adoption; published in the Official Journal on 21 October 2018.
events.quote: 04 September 2018

events.title: Trust fund case set for trial in San Francisco (reported)
events.description: BBC: the case over the missing $24m from the Tonga Trust Fund (built from passport sales) was set for trial on 1 March 2004 in a US District Court; three people and six companies were named in the suit.
events.quote: If the 1 March 2004 court date sticks

events.title: Turkey lowers citizenship-by-investment thresholds (reported)
events.description: Per the AA article, thresholds fell in September 2018 from $2m investment, $3m deposit and $1m real estate to $500,000, $500,000 and $250,000.
events.quote: Citizenship applications to Turkey are expected to boom in 2019 as the country eased its conditions in September

events.title: Interior Ministry: 6,134 citizenship decisions cancelled or withdrawn; Istanbul probe finds 1,070 irregular grants (reported)
events.description: The Ministry said 1,413 investors and family (6,134 people) had lost citizenship over false valuation reports or security grounds, and an Istanbul prosecution identified 1,070 people naturalised through sham property sales.
events.quote: Böylelikle toplam 1413 yatırımcı ve aile fertleriyle birlikte 6 bin 134 kişinin vatandaşlık kazanma kararı iptal edilmiş veya geri alınmıştır.

new_indicators.name: Revenue forgone by suspending or closing a programme (estimate)
new_indicators.definition: Government revenue a source says would be lost by suspending, closing or not starting a programme, in the period the source states. Money; an estimate, never a calculation by us.

new_indicators.name: Programme cases reviewed
new_indicators.definition: Programme applications or cases examined by an authority's review, audit or inquiry in a period (before any finding). Count; unit as printed (applications, persons).
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by fetch-cited-3 (St Kitts 2025 review of 158 applications).

new_indicators.name: Programme cases remedied after review
new_indicators.definition: Cases found deficient by an authority's review that were put right (e.g. outstanding investment paid) without sanction, in a period.

new_indicators.name: Programme marketing spending
new_indicators.definition: Money a programme authority, concessionaire or agent says it spent on promoting a programme in a period. Money; who spent it goes in notes or category=.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by fetch-cited-3 (Malta MRVP concessionaire claim, 2018).
